title.zh: 炉管退火：慢而深，适合批量热处理
title.en: Furnace annealing: slow and deep, suited to batch thermal processing

subtitle.zh: 批量均匀性、深度热处理与总热预算
subtitle.en: Batch uniformity, deep thermal processing and total thermal budget

body.zh: 炉管的优势是批量处理和长时间均温，但持续时间更长，扩散与材料兼容风险也更高。
body.en: Furnace advantages are batch processing and prolonged temperature uniformity, but longer duration also increases diffusion and material-compatibility risks.

body.zh: 水平炉管剖面示意（批量晶圆舟）
前区（预热）中心区（均温）后区（冷却辅助）
body.en: Front zone (preheat) Center zone (uniform temperature) Rear zone (assisted cooling)

body.zh: 工艺气体入口尾气排出

body.en: • Batch processing: multiple wafers in one boat

body.zh: •长时间均温，深度受热与扩散更充分
body.en: • Prolonged uniform temperature enables deeper heating and more extensive diffusion

body.zh: •气氛在不同区段变化，可能引发氧化/ 还原/污染差异
body.en: • Ambient differences between zones can cause differences in oxidation / reduction / contamination

body.zh: 缓慢升温Soak保温受控降温时间
body.en: Slow heating Soak hold Controlled cooling Time

body.zh: 炉管退火典型流程（六步）

body.en: Enter the furnace and Purge the ambient

body.zh: 关键控制要点（决定均匀性与重现性）
炉内温度均匀性• 区间温度一致性• 轴向与径向均匀• 热场校准与验证
body.en: Temperature uniformity inside the furnace • Temperature consistency between zones • Axial and radial uniformity • Thermal-field calibration and validation

body.zh: Ramp/ Soak时间•升温斜率平缓• 保温窗口稳定• 降温受控可重复
body.en: Ramp / Soak time • Gentle heating slope • Stable hold window • Controlled and repeatable cooling

body.zh: 气体纯度与流场•气体纯度稳定• 流场均匀覆盖•气氛切换可控
body.en: Gas purity and flow field • Stable gas purity • Uniform flow coverage • Controllable ambient switching

body.zh: 舟位与批间匹配• 舟位热差评估•批间匹配一致•装载方式标准化
body.en: Boat-position and batch matching • Assess thermal differences by boat position • Consistent batch matching • Standardized loading

body.zh: 批量吞吐＋深度均温• 批量处理效率高• 均温时间更充分• 适合深度反应与扩散
body.en: Batch throughput + deep temperature equilibration • High batch-processing efficiency • More time for equilibration • Suited to deep reactions and diffusion

body.zh: 更大的扩散、应力和污染累积风险• 扩散与界面反应更充分（可能过深）• 应力累积与翘曲风险上升（视材料）• 污染累积可能性增加（视气氛与材料）
body.en: Greater accumulated diffusion, stress and contamination risks • More extensive diffusion and interfacial reaction (potentially too deep) • Greater accumulated stress and warpage risk (material dependent) • Greater potential contamination accumulation (ambient and material dependent)

body.zh: 慢并不等于差；任务若需要长时间反应或批量均温，炉管仍有优势。
body.en: Slow does not mean poor; furnaces retain advantages for long reactions or batch temperature equilibration.

body.zh: 常见风险（视材料、配方与控制而定，不一定发生）
body.en: Common risks (depend on materials, recipe and controls; not inevitable)

body.zh: 量测反馈：Rs / SIMS · 膜厚/应力 · 颗粒/金属 · 舟位趋势
body.en: Metrology feedback: Rs / SIMS · thickness / stress · particles / metals · boat-position trends

body.zh: 舟位趋势前区中心区后区
body.en: Boat-position trends Front zone Center zone Rear zone

body.zh: 反馈优化 温区均匀性与时间窗口
body.en: Feedback optimizes zone uniformity and the time window

body.zh: 下游影响（需纳入工艺链评估）
炉管并不等于低端工艺；是否适用取决于反应深度、扩散容限、材料堆叠与产能策略。
body.en: Furnace processing is not inherently low-end; suitability depends on reaction depth, diffusion tolerance, the material stack and capacity strategy.
